title: test_presence_cache: missing purge_older_than boundary test
description: purge_older_than uses < comparison (line 302 of presence.py: v['ts'] < cutoff), so entries exactly at cutoff timestamp are retained. No test verifies this boundary condition. Test should verify that purge_older_than(ts) where ts equals an entry's timestamp does NOT purge that entry. File: python/tests/coap/test_presence_cache.py, TestPresenceCacheGet.test_purge_older_than_removes_stale
